title: Warehouse basics
description: Four short puzzles that teach moving the worker and pushing crates onto goals.

puzzles.title: First push
puzzles.description: Walk up to the crate and push it onto the goal.

puzzles.title: Around the corner
puzzles.description: Push the crate down, then walk around it to push it along to the goal.

puzzles.title: Two crates
puzzles.description: Push each of the two crates onto its own goal.

puzzles.title: Plan ahead
puzzles.description: Think before you push: a crate in the wrong place blocks the other one.
